Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class LinkTokenUsername

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.LinkTokenUsername
public final class LinkTokenUsername extends Object
The user name a magic link token is stored with. Spring's token store only keeps a user name next to the token, so the purpose of a link travels in it: the token of a link requested as a second factor starts with a control character that no identifier can carry (identifiers are stripped of control characters before they are used), and OttLinkAuthenticationProvider accepts it only in the session of the signed-in user it was requested for. The column holds 100 characters, so an identifier is cut to what fits; a second-factor link of a user name longer than 99 characters would be cut and never match its user, so OttGenerationSuccessHandler does not deliver it (fitsSecondFactorLink(String)).
